name: editorial-abstention-negatives-2026-10-22
protocol: A NEGATIVE corpus for the search lanes' abstention: queries whose subject is NOT in the measured scope, labelled by LOOKING at the scope rather than by a search's own scores. Every label here was established by reading the footage or the transcript, never by asking a search lane whether it found something - a lane that says 'not found' is the thing being measured, so it cannot also be the thing that says what is not there. The corpus is split in two: `tune` is the half a floor may be fitted on, and `heldout` is the half no floor is fitted on, so the reported improvement is measured on negatives the floor never saw. Each entry names the guard that keeps its label honest: `words` means the subject's words occur ZERO times in the measured transcript, and the bench REFUSES to score such an entry if that stops being true; `frames` means the subject is absent from every one of the sampled frames, which was established by looking at all of them. The three entries marked `carried_from` are the negatives the editorial sets already carried (E13, H09, H07, H08, E15); they are re-verified here against this scope, not re-labelled.

scope.corpus: GEO vs SEO podcast, two speakers (Craig, Akshita), two fixed cameras, 7 MXF sources
scope.project: ren-scratch-retrieval-bench (a Ren-owned scratch copy; the captain's project is never written to)

text_scope.note: every speech segment of the measured transcript, all seven sources

visual_scope.note: every frame the frame index sampled, over 181.58 video minutes of the seven sources

scope.what_is_actually_in_the_picture: one studio: a dark geometric acoustic-panel wall, a potted plant, a dark marble table, laptops, two speakers, and the other speaker's hands in the foreground on one camera. There is no B-roll, no cutaway, no street, no kitchen, no animal.

verification.text: The transcript of the two long takes (LC4932, 4941.10 s; LCATL0013, 4099.60 s) was read end to end - 2310 lines, every utterance - and the subject word of each negative below was counted over all 2854 speech segments of the measured scope. A subject that is absent from the words AND from a marketing-podcast topic is absent from the recording.
verification.visual: All 1092 sampled frames were looked at, as 23 contact sheets of 48 labelled frames each (clip id and second), covering every frame the frame index holds. No frame holds any of the visual subjects below. The sampling is 10 s, so an event shorter than 10 s could in principle be unsampled; every subject below is an object that would be visible for far longer than the sampling gap if it were present.
verification.who: labelled by the lane that ran this work, 2026-10-22, on the scratch copy named above
